title: land writes its ops rows from inside a test into the clone's real spool, so fixture landings reach the committed sidecars and the proposed LOG rows
goal: bl_land.ops_write writes nothing inside a test run (PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST, as ql_deliver.ops_row and tests.record_run already guard), so no fixture landing reaches the clone's spool, its committed ops sidecars or kblog proposals; a planted test run records nothing. Found by the SP-smqwmchu review: 6412 of the 6613 proposed _logs.csv rows (3556 distinct item ids no commit names) are land.end and land.step of test fixtures, not the retired fleet.
